description.zh: 请求Body。资源属性，以JSON的形式传入。
description.en: The request body. The property of the resource, which is specified in JSON format.

description.zh: 幂等参数。若云产品支持幂等能力，则传入生效。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. If a cloud service supports idempotence, the parameter takes effect.

description.zh: 地域ID。若云产品是region化产品，则此参数为必填。
description.en: The region ID. This parameter is required if a cloud service is a regionalized.

description.zh:
请求路径。格式为：
/api/v1/providers/{provider}/products/{product}/resources/{resourceType}

请求路径中变量说明：

provider: 云厂商，目前只支持Aliyun。

product: 产品Code。

resourceType: 资源类型。有父资源时，格式为{父资源类型code}/父资源ID/{资源类型code}。
description.en:
The request path. Specify this parameter in the following format: /api/v1/providers/{provider}/products/{product}/resources/{resourceType}

Variables in the request path:

provider: the Cloud service provider. Only Aliyun is supported.

product: the code of the service.

resourceType: the type of resources. If parent resource is specified, the format is {parent resource type code}/parent resource ID/{resource type code}.

descriptions.zh: 用户可前往[在线调试API门户](https://next.api.aliyun.com/cloudcontrol)查看资源文档和体验Cloud Control API。
descriptions.en: You can go to [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/cloudcontrol) to view the documentation and try out Cloud Control API.
